Video Title: Bitcoin Drops Below $70K & Extreme Fear Hits 20: 2022 vs. 2026 Bear Cycle!  
Video ID: 8i4A4auZJv4  
Bitcoin (BTC) | Class: CRYPTO  

 Current Structure  
Bitcoin is trading below $70,000 and the Fear & Greed Index has fallen into the extreme fear zone at 20 out of 100. The market is currently in a counter‑trend rally phase that began in late December 2025 and extended into late January 2026, mirroring the pattern seen in the 2022 cycle. Social sentiment is dominated by panic‑driven narratives, with the wordcloud heavily weighted toward “fear,” “sell,” and “crash.”  

 Macro Quantitative Risk  
TWAP baselines and regression fair‑value bands are not explicitly disclosed in the transcript, but the extreme fear reading signals a high TWAP risk level. The market’s recent price action below the $70,000 threshold suggests a potential undervaluation residual zone relative to the 2021 bull‑market peak. Historical volatility has spiked during the identified panic periods (Feb 2022, Nov‑Dec 2025, Mar 2026, Jun 2026, Jul 2026), indicating elevated risk of further downside.  

 Downside & Upside Targets  
Historical panic drawdowns occurred in:  
• Feb 2022 – first major drop during extreme fear  
• Nov‑Dec 2025 – initial drop before the counter‑trend rally  
• Mar 2026 – subsequent drop following the rally  
• Jun 2026 – major low before a brief rally  
• Jul 2026 – another low before the market began charting its own course  

These dates represent potential support floors for a panic‑driven drawdown. The market’s current trajectory suggests that a non‑panic drawdown floor may lie near the $70,000 level, while a deeper panic floor could approach the lows seen in Jun 2026 and Jul 2026. Cycle bull targets may align with the peak of the previous bull market in November 2021, but the market is charting a distinct path that could yield a new cycle peak in late 2026 or early 2027.
